obligations.expected_behavior: Reject the active requirement when its Acceptance is not observable.
forbidden_result: The active requirement is accepted despite non-observable Acceptance.
obligations.observable_result: The compiler reports the active requirement as rejected.
obligations.state_before: An active requirement has Acceptance that is not observable.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler
obligations.trigger: Acceptance for an active requirement is not observable.

obligations.expected_behavior: Stop processing before making any semantic model call when deterministic source preflight fails.
forbidden_result: A semantic model call is made after deterministic source preflight failure.
Semantic processing continues after deterministic source preflight failure.
obligations.observable_result: Compilation stops and no semantic model call occurs.
obligations.state_after: Processing has stopped before any semantic model call.
obligations.state_before: Deterministic source preflight has failed and semantic model processing has not started.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler

obligations.expected_behavior: Return a structured `repair-vdd` recommendation that identifies the blocking reason.
forbidden_result: No repair-vdd recommendation is returned when compilation is blocked.
The recommendation omits the blocking reason.
An unstructured recommendation is returned instead of the required structured `repair-vdd` recommendation.
obligations.observable_result: The compiler returns a structured recommendation labeled `repair-vdd` containing the blocking reason.
obligations.state_after: A structured `repair-vdd` recommendation identifying the blocking reason has been returned.
obligations.state_before: Compilation is blocked by a detected requirement or source-preflight issue.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler
obligations.trigger: A blocking reason is detected during compilation.
